claim_boundary: Reference-blind structural Pass0 only; no references, confirmation, materials, retrieval, embeddings, correction, or quality scoring.

stopping_rules.empty_response: preserve as data and continue; structural read decides
stopping_rules.non_prefix_or_duplicate_index: stop; do not repair in place

trace.resume_policy: Only an exact validated prefix may resume; orphan or drifted artifacts fail closed.

wall_clock_estimate.basis: Linear extrapolation from the 2026-08-26 40-call Pass0 after server warm-up; not an LHCP measurement.
